description:
Features:
- Mute ads on Accuradio, Spotify (Full & Lite), Pandora, Soundcloud or Any app with Custom App Option
- Casting Support: Supports casting (Google Chromecast, etc)
- Fully Configurable: Edit preloaded apps, add new custom apps, and adjust keywords or unmute delays for precise control.
- Debug Log View: Integrated logging for easy troubleshooting.
- Minimal UI & Lightweight (~ 150KB)
- No bloat/external dependencies
- All locally processed, no data collection
- No inapp purchases or ads
- Open source
If you want to know on how this works & more.. check github.
